step1_analysis.description: A power-gated diode string that generates multiple intermediate reference voltages (N0, N1, N2) for a low-VDD flip-flop or sleep control circuit. It uses diode-connected MOS transistors to create voltage drops and includes sleep transistors to pull nodes to ground during power-down mode.

paper_reference.title: Design Techniques for Single-Low-VDD CMOS Systems

v_ref_n0.description: Steady-state reference voltage at node N0

sky130_expected.calculation: Clamped by diode-connected NMOS (XM3, XM7) to ground. V(N0) ≈ Vthn.

v_ref_n1.description: Steady-state reference voltage at node N1

sky130_expected.calculation: V(N0) + Vthp (from diode-connected PMOS XM2, XM10).

v_ref_n2.description: Steady-state reference voltage at node N2

power_dc.description: Active DC power consumption of the diode string

sky130_expected.calculation: Current through the diode string (XM5 -> XM6 -> XM2/10 -> XM3/7) multiplied by VDD.
sky130_expected.reasoning: With W/L=5u/0.5u, the string will draw moderate current in active mode.

t_startup.description: Time required for reference voltages to stabilize after exiting sleep mode

sky130_expected.calculation: RC time constant of the diode string charging internal nodes (especially N1 with capacitor XM9).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Small internal capacitances and relatively strong drive currents.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure steady-state reference voltages, active power consumption, and startup time when transitioning from sleep to active mode.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Bias Generator Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

XM1 GND LABEL_NET_0 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N0 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 LABEL_NET_1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N2 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 LABEL_NET_2 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N0 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 LABEL_NET_3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N1 GND N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N0 N0 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* Sleep mode initially, then active mode at 2ns
V0 LABEL_NET_0 0 PWL(0 0 1n 0 2n 1.8)
V1 LABEL_NET_1 0 PWL(0 1.8 1n 1.8 2n 0)
V2 LABEL_NET_2 0 PWL(0 1.8 1n 1.8 2n 0)
V3 LABEL_NET_3 0 PWL(0 1.8 1n 1.8 2n 0)

.control
tran 0.1n 20n
meas tran v_ref_n0 avg v(N0) from=15n to=20n
meas tran v_ref_n1 avg v(N1) from=15n to=20n
meas tran v_ref_n2 avg v(N2) from=15n to=20n
meas tran t_startup trig v(LABEL_NET_2) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N1) val=0.5 rise=1
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
meas tran power_dc avg power from=15n to=20n
print v_ref_n0 v_ref_n1 v_ref_n2 t_startup power_dc
quit
.endc
